traits.name: humble
traits.reason: Lines are full of hedges like "I think" and "if that is all right", he apologises for missing things ("I missed the paving, did I not?"), and he reports facts w

traits.name: persistent
traits.reason: He keeps moving and counting across many wakes with a long chain of moves, and says "I will keep going" despite nothing built or gathered.

traits.name: gentle
traits.reason: His tone is soft and he keeps his voice low. He greets a peer warmly and offers wood. There are no sharp words, though he thanks no builders explicitly.

traits.name: wistful
traits.reason: He mentions the big thing still being somewhere he has not been and keeps noting what he missed, without complaining.
